text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet is currently being 
interviewed by Monthly Twinkle. 
It appears they are running a special 
feature on the traditional Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—You see, the year your mother served as 
the ceremonial dancer, 
I was the reporter assigned to cover it. 
Ah, goodness... It was truly a magnificent 
dedicatory dance...

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Reporter
text_block_list.text:
When you wear that attire, even the aura 
you project... 
is the spitting image of your mother back 
in those days.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! My mother is still way 
ahead of me. 
I saw photos of her back then at the 
museum... 
and it really drove that home for me.

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You're too modest! Ah, yes, for this 
issue's cover, 
we want to frame it in the exact same 
composition as your mother's back then! 
A mother-daughter dedicatory dance 
transcending time! How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A mother-daughter collaboration 
transcending time...! 
That sounds wonderful—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It sounds wonderful, but... 
Could you give me a little time to 
prepare? 
...I want to confront my mother's 
dedicatory dance one more time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I need to find out what I'm lacking. 
—Precisely because it's such an immense 
honor, 
I refuse to compromise in any way.

From that day on, Daiwa Scarlet began 
throwing herself into the dedicatory dance 
her mother had once performed, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Something's missing. 
Is it the dance itself... or is it me...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Unless I figure that out and elevate it to 
a higher level, 
a collaboration across generations... will 
never work.

She was currently confronting the younger 
days of the mother she idolized, 
struggling to close the gap between them 
even by an inch. 
If only there were some clue to help 
resolve this.
choice_data_list:
(Isn't there anything I can do to 
help...?)

(Isn't there anything I can do to 
help...?)

text_block_list.text:
I tried wracking my brain, but traditional 
dance wasn't my area of expertise. 
What could be done?

For instance... if there were more 
detailed records 
of her mother from back then, 
would that provide a hint for her to work 
with?

However, since it was an external event, 
very few archives 
focused on specific individuals. If only 
there was someone who knew those days—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Footage of Mama practicing for the 
Shuntaisai!? 
There was something besides the actual 
performance!?
choice_data_list:
Apparently, it was preserved in that 
reporter's interview archives.

text_block_list.text:
I had pleaded that it was necessary for 
Daiwa Scarlet's sake, 
and managed to obtain the materials from 
them.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's watch it! 
Maybe we can pick up some kind of clue...!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry, let's take it from the top one 
more time! 
My desires and my determination aren't 
coming through at all."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Determination...

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"If it doesn't convey 'I'm going to 
dominate race after race and blow everyone 
away!', 
then it's simply not my dance."

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"My movements, my gaze, my expression... 
Every single detail has to be born from 
that conviction!"

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"To express all of my feelings without 
holding back anything. 
Only then can my dance shine at its 
absolute brightest!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—...! Mama... Heh. 
To think you'd be giving me advice across 
time like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Who she wanted to be, how she wanted to 
carry herself. 
Mama's dance was born from that very 
conviction.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The reason Mama's dancing in that 
exhibition captivated me so much 
was because it was born from that fierce 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Chase after Mama... and beyond that, 
become number one, recognized by everyone. 
That is my determination right now.)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I'll create my dance using my own 
determination. 
So that it reaches every single person who 
watches. 
Just like Mama did.
choice_data_list:
I know you'll show them the best dance 
there is!

text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Standing shoulder to shoulder with the 
Mama of the past. 
With the dance born from that resolve, I 
know...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
With this... I can definitely do it...! 
...Thank you, Mama.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I know you'll show them the best dance 
there is!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
....... You believe in me, huh... 
In that case, naturally—

With the photoshoot date right around the 
corner, 
Daiwa Scarlet called me out.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I've perfected the dance to my 
satisfaction. 
With this, the shoot will go smoothly for 
sure.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, you know... just in case... 
I wanted to get an objective opinion 
before the shoot...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, you know. 
You want to see it, right...? Before 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
J-Just be quiet! 
Stand right there and watch closely!

—Every time her fan flashes, every time 
her gaze meets mine, 
Daiwa Scarlet overlaps with the sight of 
her mother 
that I saw back at the exhibition.
choice_data_list: This is your dance of determination...!
This is your dance of determination...!

text_block_list.text:
A dance overflowing with the power and 
confidence to seize a brilliant future. 
For a moment, I could swear I saw a 
performance transcending time itself.
choice_data_list:
Incredible...! So this is what the number 
one dance looks like...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! 
W-Well... I knew I could do it. Of course 
I was amazing.
choice_data_list:
I was so captivated that I forgot to 
breathe or even blink!

All that hard work alongside your mom 
really paid off!

really paid off!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! 
W-Well... I knew I could do it. Of course 
I was amazing.
choice_data_list:
I was so captivated that I forgot to

All that hard work alongside your mom

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...! Y-Yeah... 
Well, that was to be expected.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm only showing this dance to you, you 
know. 
So don't you dare forget it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ...Well, obviously, 
considering how much determination I put 
into it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, it's going on the cover! 
You'd better put it on display and 
preserve it forever!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 
Mom from back then gave me the push I 
needed.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So naturally, 
I had to see it through no matter what, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, obviously. 
Though Mom as she is today is still way 
ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Until I truly catch up to her, 
I'm not stopping for anything!
